All updates
Who we are

About THLI

Get value, give value.

Founded in May 2025 through a God-inspired vision, Treasured Hands Ladies Initiative is committed to educating, equipping and empowering girls and women. We believe every girl deserves access to knowledge, dignity, encouragement and opportunities to grow. Our work brings together learning, menstrual-health outreach, faith-inspired service and community support.

Our purpose

To help girls and women learn, build confidence, make informed decisions and contribute positively to their communities. Through education and practical care, we aim to reach more girls every year.

Community impact

Our Work

Pad a Girl Child 1.0

THLI's first documented outreach brought together volunteers to support girls and encourage conversations around menstrual health and dignity.

Pad a Girl Child 2.0

At Aveco, THLI volunteers engaged students and distributed sanitary pad supplies as part of the foundation's continued outreach work.

Leadership

Meet the Founder

Founder, THLI

Lady Treasure Ojo-tule

Lady Treasure Ojo-tule is the founder of Treasured Hands Ladies Initiative (THLI), a faith-inspired initiative established in May 2025 to educate, encourage and empower girls and women.

Known as “The Supernatural Writer,” she is a writer, public speaker and passionate girl-child advocate. She has spoken at various gatherings, using her voice to raise awareness, inspire confidence and encourage girls to recognise their value and potential.

Through THLI, she champions access to menstrual hygiene essentials, meaningful education, mentorship and guidance. Her leadership brings together volunteers and supporters who believe every girl deserves dignity, knowledge and the opportunity to thrive.

Her vision is to grow THLI’s outreach, reach more girls and build partnerships that turn compassion into practical, lasting support.

Be part of our community

Join Us

Connect. Volunteer. Make a difference.

Join a growing community of more than 200 girls where encouragement, learning and meaningful connection matter. Whether you want to learn, share your skills or support others, THLI welcomes your interest.

With 15 volunteers and sanitary-pad outreach reaching more than 200 girls annually, we are working to expand our impact. Volunteers can contribute time and skills; partners can support education, menstrual dignity, outreach materials, mentorship and responsible programme growth. Your support helps us plan more activities and reach more girls.
